text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh, dammit...!
To think I'd let it slip away...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So this is a Long-distance GⅠ... Insane...
The road to being the strongest ain't easy at all...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, gasp, gasp*...
I'm... so dizzy~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither Jungle Pocket nor Dantsu Flame
could claim victory.
The Kikuka Sho was truly no walk in the park.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer-san.
We learned quite a lot from this race.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Not just Pokke, but the various aptitudes of other Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame.
Unable to produce her usual expansive stride, she was thoroughly exhausted. The reason was—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan... great work.
Today made everything crystal clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "I knew it... I really can't walk down the same path as Pokke-chan going forward."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Dants, why?
Even today, you ran pretty well...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, it's my own body, so I know best.
I couldn't run using my speed the way I used to.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Since summer, I kind of had a feeling.
That maybe long distances
just aren't for me."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“I really, really wanted to run
the 『Kikuka Sho』 with Pokke-chan, though!
No matter what, I just had to...!”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So today... I'm really happy♪
Starting tomorrow, I have to go. On my very own path.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: From here on, I'm going to take the mile route to make the most of my speed. So...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for everything up until now.
See ya...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dants...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(You too, huh... You survived it all.
And yet you're leaving anyway...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Another one I thought I could rival forever.
And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dantsu—!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's meet again next year!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, Pokke-chan...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If it's 2000m or 2200m, we can manage somehow!
Next time, in a medium-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Go conquer the mile division!
And let's race again someday!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our paths diverge.
However, that doesn't mean they will never cross again.
Dantsu Flame walked away with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Dants wasn't suited for long distances. On the other hand, the one who showed tremendous aptitude was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe. Though victory eluded her,
there was no doubt she possessed
tremendous latent potential.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be soon.
It seems you've drawn close to full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume closest to destiny.
Perhaps even more so than Tachyon.
choice_data_list: Wait, then what about Fuji Kiseki...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've been curious about her for a while now.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I sent her a warning as well.
By calling her to the same place as Tachyon, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did you understand?
Tachyon, and...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I truly hope you will accept
my advice on your running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The other girl who was in that place was...
Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was an Umamusume like an apparition, which is probably why Jungle Pocket didn't notice her.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad, Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Never thought there'd still be someone among the unknowns
who could actually give me a run for my money.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I won't... compete with you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm just... chasing after my "friend."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Friends?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of Umamusume she was remained a mystery.
However, from next year onward, she looked set to become
a formidable rival for Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Cafe, I'll take my sweet time settling things with you. But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, there's someone—there are people
I have to settle things with."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Look at the stands.
They're here, all right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Jungle Pocket's gaze,
I turned to look—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There she stood, calmly watching over us—
the strongest active Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Doto? Top Road-san?
What did you think of the new actors' running this year?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... it was pretty amazing~
Not quite on Opera O-san's level, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... There are so many girls with fierce
running styles. Like sparks are flying, in a way.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so? Then let us see
just how fierce those sparks can be.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“—In the upcoming 'Japan Cup'.
Against the three of us!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent declaration to run. And a declaration to fight back.
T.M. Opera O isn't the only opponent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in their shadows, always putting in solid performances, is the indomitable Meisho Doto. Narita Top Road, ever the consistent overachiever, is also likely to make an appearance.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, three of them, huh?
Now that's what I call quite the welcome party."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
But—don't underestimate us. We've got this too...
Right, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wait, hey, where are you going!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Toward where my "friend" is heading.
I won't go—with you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you serious!?
I'm the only one from our class here, hey!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tch, whatever. I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O!
I'm the one who's gonna kick your ass off that throne!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's finally time to challenge for the top, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dethrone the top dog running the Umamusume world and reign supreme. We're seizing the pinnacle, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, the title of the strongest is right before our eyes!
Yeah, being the strongest is right before our eyes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat Agnes Tachyon. Guided by that very first
goal I set, I've made it this far."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her opponent is the strongest, the Overlord of the Century's End.
In the Japan Cup,
will Jungle Pocket's fangs reach him?"
